data.revised_prompt:
Create a publication-quality wide scientific method figure in a clean vector-like computer-science journal style, matching the look of a polished SCI paper diagram on a white background. Aspect ratio 1536x512, very wide horizontal time-unrolled layout. Preserve a dense but readable layout with the same palette as a modern perception-control pipeline figure: light blue/cyan modules, green policy-related boxes, orange camera update box, blue/purple dynamics box, black forward arrows, red backward gradient arrows, dashed red for stopped/optional gradients. Clean alignment, crisp labels, thin rounded rectangles, elegant arrow routing, no 3D effects, no clutter.

The figure should show exactly one time step t and the transition to t+1, not multiple repeated stages. Use a polished journal-figure appearance with one left state node and one right next-state node.

Overall structure:
- Left circular node labeled "x_t, c_t".
- A geometric renderer module labeled "R(x_t, E)" producing "D_raw,t".
- An active-depth sensor module labeled "S_phi" receiving inputs from D_raw,t, c_t, rho_t, and x_t. Do NOT show x_t or c_t as outputs of S_phi.
- Use the existing depth-image/photo style representation for the observed depth image node labeled "D_obs,t". Place it below/near S_phi and route it into the policy box.
- Near S_phi include side output text "Q_t, M_t" with a small subtitle "quality / validity". This side output should connect to the sensing/teacher loss only, not to the policy.
- Feature/state encoders labeled "psi_flight, psi_cam" and outputs "s_t, m_t" feeding the policy.
- A single policy box labeled "Pi_theta". Do NOT split it into two boxes. Inside or just under it, show outputs "u_t, c*_{t+1}".
- Dynamics box labeled "f_dyn" with output "x_{t+1}".
- Camera update module labeled "EMA" with output "c_{t+1}".
- Right next-state circular node labeled "x_{t+1}, c_{t+1}".
- Bottom loss node 1 labeled "L_flight" with small subtitle "ell_nav(x,u)".
- Bottom loss node 2 labeled "L_sens / L_teach" with small subtitle "fill(M), quality(Q)".
- Add a small note near the camera/policy branch: "flight-only: sg[c*], theta_cam fixed".
- Add a compact legend on the far right: black = forward rollout; red = backward gradient; dashed red = stopped/optional.

Forward data flow, exact routing:
1) x_t goes to R(x_t, E), which outputs D_raw,t.
2) D_raw,t goes to S_phi.
3) c_t, rho_t, and x_t also feed into S_phi as inputs.
4) S_phi outputs D_obs,t, and D_obs,t feeds directly into the single Pi_theta policy box.
5) S_phi also outputs Q_t, M_t to the sensing/teacher loss area; these do not feed into Pi_theta.
6) x_t and c_t also feed into psi_flight, psi_cam to form s_t, m_t; s_t, m_t feed into Pi_theta.
7) Pi_theta outputs u_t and c*_{t+1} from the same single policy box.
8) u_t goes to f_dyn, and f_dyn outputs x_{t+1}.
9) c*_{t+1} goes to EMA. c_t also goes to EMA. EMA outputs c_{t+1}.
10) x_{t+1} and c_{t+1} merge into the next-state node, then continue to the next time step.

Backward gradient arrows, exact routing and style:
- L_flight sends red gradient arrows to x_{t+1}/f_dyn and to u_t/Pi_theta, then continues backward through D_obs,t to S_phi. Do NOT draw a solid red arrow updating the camera branch in flight-only.
- L_sens / L_teach sends red gradient arrows through Q_t, M_t and S_phi back to camera parameters / teacher candidate c_bar or c_t.
- Use dashed red near the camera output branch to indicate an available but stopped/frozen gradient in flight-only: "sg[c*], theta_cam fixed".
- If showing exposure timing, make it a subtle dashed optional red arrow labeled "Delta t_t" or omit it if it hurts readability.

Visual design details:
- Keep the layout density and polished appearance close to a top-tier SCI figure.
- Use thin, crisp black arrows for forward rollout; thick enough red arrows for gradients.
- Make module boxes rounded, lightly tinted, with consistent typography.
- Use clean math-style labels, legible at 1536x512.
- Preserve the observed depth image/photo treatment: a tiny grayscale depth snapshot with the label D_obs,t beside/below it.
- Ensure one Pi_theta box only, no separate policy boxes.
- Ensure Q_t, M_t do not feed into Pi_theta.
- Ensure S_phi does not output x_t or c_t.
- Ensure no solid red flight-loss arrow updates the camera branch; camera branch should only show dashed/stopped gradient indication.

Compose the full figure so it reads left-to-right across the single time step and into t+1, with tidy arrow bends and no spaghetti. Render as a crisp publication-ready scientific diagram.
